title: Personal experiment dashboard - Evelyn
content:
One-page personal dashboard for quick experiment logging and triage. Use this as my scratch mini-sheet when iterating on batching / quantization / cache strategies. Fast capture format — rows appended as I run jobs on my laptop / staging cluster.

Column defs (short):
- run_id: short id (date + tag)
- date: YYYY-MM-DD
- model: model name / variant (e.g., lla-13b-int8)
- config: quant/batching notes (e.g., int8, q4_0, halfKV)
- batch: effective batch size (requests merged)
- seq: avg seq len used for p50/p95
- latency_p50_ms: median per-token or per-response latency in ms
- latency_p95_ms: p95 latency ms
- tokens: total tokens generated in run
- cost_per_1k: estimated $ / 1k tokens for the run (back-of-envelope)
- eval_delta: quick subjective quality delta vs baseline (+/-)
- notes: quick context, failures, config diffs, links

Quick table (append-only samples):
run_id | date | model | config | batch | seq | latency_p50_ms | latency_p95_ms | tokens | cost_per_1k | eval_delta | notes
2025-11-02-a | 2025-11-02 | lla-13b | int8 q4_0 no-KV | 1 | 64 | 42 | 110 | 2,400 | 0.42 | -0.01 (slightly more halluc)
2025-11-10-b | 2025-11-10 | lla-13b | int8 q4_0 half-KV | 2 | 128 | 36 | 92 | 8,000 | 0.28 | neutral, p95 improved
2026-01-07-c | 2026-01-07 | lla-13b | fp16 full-KV | 1 | 256 | 78 | 200 | 15,000 | 0.95 | gold quality, expensive
2026-02-18-d | 2026-02-18 | lla-13b | int8 q2_kvcache | 4 | 96 | 30 | 82 | 28,000 | 0.18 | promising, minor regressions on rare tokens

Interpretation notes (quick):
- int8 + partial KV gives best cost/latency trade for mid-length sequences (64-128).
- full FP16 still leads in quality for edge-case prompts; keep as fallback path.
- batching 4 seems stable when sequence distribution is small; watch p95 tail when bursty long seqs appear.

Immediate TODOs (self):
- [ ] Run 10-shot stress with batch=8 + q2_kvcache to confirm p95 tail (ticket JIRA-ENG-7891).
- [ ] Capture server-side traces for 2026-02-18-d run (link above).
- [ ] Add small eval set (5 prompts) to automatically compute eval_delta next time.

Questions / flags to resolve later:
- How to normalize cost across different hardware? (want $/1k tokens relative to T4 baseline).
- Is the minor hallucination pattern tied to quantization of embeddings or attention kernel? Quick hypothesis: kvcache compression + q2 quant introduces small numeric drift.

Scratch notes (short):
- When I run locally, prefix-cache warmup matters — first 50 requests show different p50. Add warmup flag for future runs.
- Slack refs: #eng-infer thread "kv-cache experiments" — post short summary after next stable run.

Log conventions: append with run_id + short comment so I can grep later. Keep this file as the single-source scratch for ad-hoc run results; transfer clean table into `/shared_drives/engineering/applied-ml/experiments` when ready.

End of mini-dashboard.
